chunks: Unless [it is] a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His bounty has been upon you great.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah's mercy and favor upon the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores that the Prophet’s unique spiritual station and authority are not inherent but are bestowed solely through divine mercy (rahmah), reinforcing the concept of divine election (ijaba). It serves as a foundational reminder for the faithful that all prophetic merits are gifts from Allah, encouraging gratitude and humility in following the Ahl al-Bayt who embody this divine favor.
